settings_intro: Account, API keys for server-to-server calls, and this instance.
settings_account_auth_off: Authentication looks off on this instance — every API call is unauthenticated, so there is no signed-in account to show. Enable auth on the server to sign in.
settings_api_keys_description: Keys authenticate server-to-server calls. A key's secret is shown once and never again.
settings_create_key_description: Name it for where it will be used. Copy the secret now — it cannot be shown again.
settings_copy_by_hand: Select the key above and copy it by hand if the button failed.
settings_label_required: Give this key a label to continue.
settings_keys_need_auth_body: This instance has auth off, so keys cannot be issued. Enable auth on the server first.
settings_keys_empty_body: Create one to call the API from a backend or CI job.
settings_revoke_description: It stops authenticating immediately and permanently. The row is kept so an audit still has something to name.
settings_about_unavailable: The health endpoint did not answer.
